description: Chat mailbox location key (48-byte SHA-384) and hybrid Ed25519+ML-DSA-65 mailbox blob v2 (section 14.6).

mailboxBlobV2Rejected.name: tamperedEd25519Signature
mailboxBlobV2Rejected.description: Strict-AND: flipping one bit in the Ed25519 signature must fail even when ML-DSA-65 verifies.

mailboxBlobV2Rejected.name: tamperedMldsa65Signature
mailboxBlobV2Rejected.description: Strict-AND: flipping one bit in the ML-DSA-65 signature must fail even when Ed25519 verifies.

mailboxBlobV2Rejected.name: missingMldsa65Signature
mailboxBlobV2Rejected.description: A v2 mailbox blob missing signatureMldsa65 must be dropped.

mailboxBlobV2Rejected.name: wrongMldsaContext
mailboxBlobV2Rejected.description: ML-DSA-65 signature produced under palexplorer-mailbox-v1 instead of palexplorer-mailbox-v2 must fail.

mailboxBlobV2Rejected.name: identityPinMismatch
mailboxBlobV2Rejected.description: Valid signatures under a different ML-DSA-65 key fail the pinned hybrid identity digest check.

mailboxBlobV2Rejected.name: v1DowngradeFromV2CapablePal
mailboxBlobV2Rejected.description: A legacy v1 blob from a v2-capable pal must be rejected with E_MAILBOX_DOWNGRADE.

mailboxBlobV2Rejected.name: exceeds24KiBLimit
mailboxBlobV2Rejected.description: A v2 mailbox blob exceeding 24 KiB (24,576 bytes) must be rejected with E_MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE.
